subject: C31
required_fixes: R1 (high) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/change_domain.rs:1062-1067 discards unsettled Runtime changes when their context retires; only Gateway changes with local bookkeeping are detached and retained. A tenant switch or credential replacement after a Version/Delete was sent can therefore erase the only record that would update the originating tenant's rotation. Returning can show no issuance/reminder, or an acknowledged rotation whose old key was actually deleted, without an unconfirmed outcome or usable reconciliation. Retain tenant-bound rotation settlement bookkeeping independently of disclosure authority. Acceptance: switch/replace credentials after dispatch but before settlement for both Version and Delete; the originating tenant retains the established or unconfirmed state and can reconcile without another mutation, the other tenant sees none of it, and no secret or retired authority revives.

R2 (high) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/rotation_domain.rs:202-204,248-250,269-270 ignores save_with failures. authority.rs:2394-2420 restores the previous Data on a failed save, while sync_changes has already marked the corresponding change settled. A successful remote issuance can permanently lose its rotation and reminder; a successful removal can lose its completion timestamp. Nothing retries that settlement or reports the lost rotation save. Preserve these remote facts with explicit unsaved/pending persistence state and recovery, without replaying the remote operation. Acceptance: inject ScriptedStore save failures at issuance, removal, and reconciliation; report the persistence failure, preserve safe reconciliation/secret disposal, then persist the original facts and timestamps after storage recovers and verify them after restart with no additional POST/DELETE.

R3 (medium) — apps/desktop/src/v2/admin/review-sheet.tsx:137-146 ignores the acknowledgeDeployment dispatch outcome and opens the old-key Delete review even when the core refuses the acknowledgement. An independent component probe reproduced a removal workbench after deniedStore with deploymentAcknowledgedAt still null. This breaks the required Version → recorded acknowledgement → Delete sequence and can leave a completed rotation without its first timestamp. Advance only after native acknowledgement is established; surface refusals and resolve unconfirmed delivery through observation. Acceptance: deniedStore, invalidInput, stale context, and unconfirmed delivery cannot open removal before the matching acknowledgement appears; a successful acknowledgement opens it once.

R4 (medium) — apps/desktop/src/features/administration/administration-view.tsx:119-131 still routes an inReview Harness proposal to local setChange, but :481 suppresses that workbench whenever the v2 onReview callback is supplied. The new Administration wrapper consequently opens no review sheet for the existing Review in Administration action. An independent embedded-view probe found neither a workbench nor an onReview call. Route the exact native-bound proposal into the v2 sheet, including proposals for a different resource/tab. Acceptance: the production Harness action navigates into a visible review with the exact proposed draft and native review ID; typed confirmation/native approval remain required, and closing discards the review correctly.

R5 (medium) — apps/desktop/src/v2/admin/review-sheet.tsx:326-368 renders the non-key applied panel without the name, revision, readback time and tenant required by screens/reviews-administration.md. The retained review-applied screenshot confirms that it contains only generic success text and Done; the original editor is not a receipt for the returned revision or time. Render the established result metadata with a core-recorded readback timestamp, explicitly labelling unavailable fields. Acceptance: a topic update's applied panel identifies the reviewed tenant/resource, returned name and revision, and stable readback time; later observations do not recompute that time, and unconfirmed changes never receive confirmed metadata.
